recovered_implementation.hcli.runtime_iface: hcli/runtime_iface.py — six planes (model semantics, backend, session, context, health, performance profile). Not a sidecar capability bus.
recovered_implementation.hcli.tool_registry.ToolRegistry: hcli/tool_registry.py — typed ToolSpec, discover(), invoke() returns ToolResult (UNKNOWN_TOOL is fail-open). default_tool_registry lists 32 tools; future_tools=[].
